info.title: Ryu Notify API
info.summary: Tenant-scoped events, approvals, live activities and delivery.
info.description:
Ryu Notify is a tenant-scoped event inbox for products and agents: durable event history, interactive approvals, live activities, Server-Sent Events, and signed, retrying delivery to webhook, ntfy and BuzzKit destinations.

Every `/v1` request carries one tenant's bearer key. Hosted Notify (`https://notify.ryuhq.com`) is in early access: Ryu provisions the key; there is no self-serve signup. The self-hosted service is not yet published.

Errors share one envelope: `{ ok: false, type: "notify.error", code, message, status, requestId, error: { code, message, status, requestId, details? } }`, with the request id also in `X-Request-ID`. A request whose Accept names `application/problem+json` gets RFC 9457 problem details instead (`NotifyProblem`): `type`, `title`, `status`, `detail`, `instance`, `code` and `docs`, plus every legacy member except `type`. A replayed publish answers 200 with `idempotent: true`; Notify sends no `Idempotent-Replayed` header.

A known path called with a method it does not serve answers `405 method_not_allowed` with an `Allow` header (the `NotifyError405` response); `HEAD` is served wherever `GET` is, `OPTIONS` on a known path answers `204` with `Allow`, and an unknown path answers `404 not_found`. With a publish limit configured, publishes carry `RateLimit` and `RateLimit-Policy` (draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers-11, policy `publish`). Destinations with a secret receive Standard Webhooks headers (`webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, `webhook-signature`) beside `X-Ryu-Notify-Signature`.

servers.description: Ryu-hosted Notify: early access, with Ryu-provisioned tenant keys. It can run an earlier release than this document, so a client should also accept the legacy `notify.error` envelope and a destination delivery signed only with `X-Ryu-Notify-Signature`.
Another Notify base URL, such as one Ryu issues with an early-access key.

post.description: What Notify POSTs to a `webhook` destination's `url` for each new event it matches. With a `secret`, verify `webhook-signature` (Standard Webhooks; a library needs `whsec_` plus the base64 of the secret) or `X-Ryu-Notify-Signature`, which signs only the body and has no replay protection. Attempts are durable and retried with backoff; see `GET /v1/deliveries`. `ntfy` destinations receive the event body as text with ntfy headers instead.

parameters.name: X-Ryu-Notify-Delivery
parameters.description: The delivery id; a retry keeps it.

parameters.name: X-Ryu-Notify-Signature
parameters.description: `sha256=` and the hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body. Sent only when the destination has a `secret`; the HMAC key is the secret's UTF-8 bytes.

parameters.name: webhook-id
parameters.description: The delivery id, the same as `X-Ryu-Notify-Delivery`. Sent only when the destination has a `secret`. A retry of the same delivery keeps it; deduplicate on it.

parameters.name: webhook-timestamp
parameters.description: Unix seconds when this attempt was sent. Reject a delivery whose timestamp is far from your clock (the Standard Webhooks libraries allow five minutes).

parameters.name: webhook-signature
parameters.description: `v1,` and the base64 HMAC-SHA256 of `<webhook-id>.<webhook-timestamp>.<raw body>`, keyed with the UTF-8 bytes of the destination `secret`. Compare in constant time; the Standard Webhooks and Svix libraries verify it.

TenantBearer.description: One Notify tenant's key, sent as Authorization: Bearer. Repeated invalid keys from one address are backed off with 429 rate_limited.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size. Defaults to 100; values above the route's cap are clamped to it.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes a publish safe to retry: the first result is stored under this key and replayed, and the same key with a different body answers 409 idempotency_conflict. Up to 128 characters; the SDK sends a UUID.

IdempotencyKeyRequired.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyRequired.description: Makes a publish safe to retry: the first result is stored under this key and replayed, and the same key with a different body answers 409 idempotency_conflict. Up to 128 characters; the SDK sends a UUID.

RateLimit.description: Remaining quota for the policy in effect, per draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers-11 (a Structured Field List, e.g. `"default";r=0;t=30`). Sent by the limiters that expose a remaining count; the per-key API limiter does not yet, so a 429 here may carry no rate-limit fields.

RateLimitPolicy.description: The quota policy, per draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers-11 (a Structured Field List, e.g. `"default";q=100;w=60`).

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (RFC 9110 §10.2.3), when the server knows it.

Deprecation.description: Present only on a deprecated route: when it was or will be deprecated, as an RFC 9745 Structured Field Date (`@<unix seconds>`). No route is deprecated today.

Sunset.description: Present only on a deprecated route with a removal date: the HTTP-date after which it may stop responding (RFC 8594).

Link.description: On a deprecated route, `rel="deprecation"` links the versioning and deprecation policy (RFC 9745 §3) and `rel="successor-version"` the replacement.

IdempotentReplayed.description: `true` when the response is a replay stored for the request's `Idempotency-Key`.

WWWAuthenticate.description: Bearer challenge (RFC 6750) naming the protected resource metadata (RFC 9728 `resource_metadata`).
